title: BridgeTwist: Twisting Schr\"odinger Bridges for Training-Free Conditional Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.18658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative models are often required to serve many downstream conditional tasks. In the training-free setting, a pretrained unconditional model is reused as a prior and combined with a task-specific likelihood to sample from the corresponding posterior. While such training-free samplers have been developed for diffusion and flow models, their counterpart for Schr\"odinger bridge (SB) models remains unexplored, despite the growing appeal of SBs as flexible stochastic transport models between general source and target distributions. We propose BridgeTwist, a training-free conditional sampler for pretrained SB generative models, formulated as a tempered twisted sequential Monte Carlo scheme. Its twist is a closed-form plug-in surrogate, obtained by combining the velocity and score fields exposed by SB pretraining into an endpoint predictor and evaluating the likelihood there. translated_title: BridgeTwist：扭转薛定谔桥以实现免训练条件采样
translated_abstract: 生成模型通常需要服务于多种下游条件任务。在免训练的设置下，预训练的无条件模型被复用为先验，并与任务特定的似然函数相结合，从而从相应的后验分布中采样。尽管针对扩散模型和流模型已开发出此类免训练采样器，但作为在一般源分布与目标分布之间进行灵活随机输运的模型，薛定谔桥（SB）正日益受到关注，而其对应的免训练采样器却尚未被探索。我们提出了BridgeTwist，一种面向预训练薛定谔桥生成模型的免训练条件采样器，其被表述为一种带温度调节的扭转序贯蒙特卡洛方案。其中的扭转量是一个闭式的即插即用代理，通过将SB预训练所暴露的速度场与得分场组合为一个终端预测器，并在该终端处评估似然函数而得到。由于该代理在靠近源分布处可靠性较低，我们对其进行了温度调节……
tldr: 提出了BridgeTwist，一种基于带温度调节扭转序贯蒙特卡洛方案的免训练条件采样器，可复用预训练薛定谔桥生成模型，利用由速度场与得分场构造的闭式即插即用扭转代理实现条件后验采样。
en_tdlr: BridgeTwist is a training-free conditional sampler for pretrained Schrödinger bridge models, formulated as a tempered twisted sequential Monte Carlo scheme that uses a closed-form plug-in twist surrogate built from SB's velocity and score fields to sample from the posterior.
